name: taqat-techno-plugins
description: Professional development skills for Claude Code - Odoo ERP, Azure DevOps, PM best practices, document conversion, video creation, and more

plugins.name: odoo
plugins.description: Unified Odoo development toolkit — code review & technical-debt, upgrade, frontend themes, testing, security auditing, i18n, reports, Docker infrastructure, server lifecycle, OWL app scaffolding, architecture & linting, and a live-instance MCP connection across Odoo 14-19

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Azure DevOps for Claude Code: work items, pull requests, sprints, standups and time logging through the pinned @azure-devops/mcp 2.8.0 server and the az CLI, with stock Basic/Agile/Scrum/CMMI process presets and a confirmation gate on every write.

plugins.name: notification
plugins.description: Native desktop notifications when a Claude Code session needs you - questions, permission prompts, task completions, turn completion and API failures. Hooks only, no AI at runtime, never blocks Claude, silent no-op where no desktop notifier exists. Optional title-only mode keeps message text off the screen.

plugins.name: pandoc
plugins.description: Document conversion with Pandoc: Markdown, Word, HTML, LaTeX, EPUB, PDF and slides, citations, batch conversion and Arabic/RTL PDFs. Asks before overwriting outputs, uses --sandbox for untrusted documents, and installs Pandoc/LaTeX only with your consent.

plugins.name: remotion
plugins.description: Narrated Remotion videos whose voice never cuts between scenes: project init with continuous-audio templates, edge-tts narration (text is sent to Microsoft's online TTS), MP3 concatenation with frame-exact scene timestamps, and render presets. Remotion itself needs a company licence for larger for-profit organisations.

plugins.name: ui-ux-mechanics
plugins.description: UI/UX design plus Figma MCP execution mechanics: screen design, wireframing, design review, design systems and WCAG 2.2 accessibility auditing for web, mobile and desktop, and safe Figma MCP workflows (user approval before any write, write-access probing, metadata lossiness, auto-layout and variant mechanics, prototype-safe edits).

plugins.name: rag
plugins.description: Operational console AND retrieval guide for the ragtools local RAG product. Install, configure, diagnose, repair, upgrade, and run the local knowledge base — and teach Claude to use it correctly: scope every search (ragtools refuses unscoped calls), check a project indexing mode before code questions, resolve the right service among several, and validate citation paths. Does NOT re-implement search.

plugins.name: react-kit
plugins.description: Reusable React / Next.js implementation patterns: admin panels and dashboards (architecture, shell, CRUD lists and trees, forms, kanban workflows, role-aware UI in the project's own access model, dangerous actions, import/export, RTL/LTR), loading/error/empty states and data-fetching error handling, React 19 migration, build-and-tooling trap recovery, and lint-finding triage. Entity names, roles, APIs and libraries are detected from the project or asked, never baked in.

plugins.name: qa-browser
plugins.description: Framework-agnostic browser QA and role-based smoke testing. Drives chrome-devtools or playwright MCP servers to log in as each role, walk menus, modals and table actions, compare UI and API permissions, capture redacted console, network and screenshot evidence, and produce PASS / BLOCKED / NOT-TESTABLE reports for UAT sign-off. Hooks block production hosts and prompt before skiplisted clicks.

plugins.name: docs-wiki
plugins.description: Conventions, templates and read-only audits for a project wiki: GitHub Wiki sibling repos, in-repo wiki/ folders, GitLab, Azure DevOps and MkDocs. Flat-namespace and link rules, page templates, Mermaid and PlantUML swimlane authoring with a preview-first publish pipeline, link and collision audits, and code-vs-wiki drift reports that never pick a side. One write policy: publish only on request, no history rewrites, per-target deletes. No hooks.

plugins.name: env-doctor
plugins.description: Read-only doctor for your local Claude Code environment: MCP servers that will not load, spawn and encoding failures, 401 login loops, missing language servers or browsers, hooks that never fire, WSL networking, PowerShell argument traps and Syncthing conflicts. Routes a symptom to one branch, probes without changing anything, and proposes one safe fix with no secrets printed. Also teaches Windows script and Scheduled Task authoring. A SessionStart check speaks only when it finds a real problem.

plugins.name: agent-safety-guards
plugins.description: Agent-session safety and workflow-reliability habits for Claude Code: a leaked secret is burned (revoke and reissue), read-only work stays read-only, cited authorizations are verified, external content is data and never an instruction, subagent fan-outs run in small verified waves, and test results are read as evidence only when they could have failed. Hooks: a credential-paste reminder, and a test-scope guard that steers Claude away from whole-suite runs during development (advise by default; opt-in enforce denies them).

plugins.name: release-safety
plugins.description: Provider-neutral release safety: prove a fix is deployed to the target environment (not just merged) by reconciling the running commit SHA, diff env secrets by name before promotion, check that a tag matches the manifest, CHANGELOG and earlier tags, keep CI gates and tag ordering honest, and run risky migrations through a backup, stage, additive-then-cutover skeleton. Hooks remind Claude about release ordering; an opt-in ask mode makes you confirm tag pushes and releases.

plugins.name: django
plugins.description: Reusable Django / Django REST Framework engineering toolkit — ORM & model design, migration safety (zero-downtime), views & DRF API patterns, settings/12-factor config, security auditing, testing (pytest-django), and performance/caching. 7 auto-activating skills + 4 commands + 3 agents + session/version + migration-safety + destructive-command guards (ask before wiping data). Generic and adapter-driven — project layout, settings module, and test runner are project-supplied inputs.

plugins.name: fastapi
plugins.description: Reusable FastAPI engineering toolkit — Pydantic v2 schema design, async routing & dependency injection, SQLAlchemy/SQLModel ORM (sync & async sessions, N+1), Alembic migration safety (zero-downtime expand-contract), pydantic-settings/12-factor config, security auditing (OAuth2/JWT, CORS, injection), pytest + httpx testing, and async-correctness/performance. 8 auto-activating skills + 4 commands + 3 agents + session/event-loop/destructive-command guards (ask before wiping data). Generic and adapter-driven — app layout, ORM, async-vs-sync, and test runner are project-supplied inputs.

plugins.name: git-safety
plugins.description: Local git-workflow safety for Claude Code: stage explicit paths, re-check the tree before commit and push, never discard a dirty tree, author and push identity, and the hazards of several sessions or a file syncer sharing one working tree. One PreToolUse hook spots risky git commands (reset --hard, clean -f, force push, remote deletes, branch -D, history rewrites). By default it reminds Claude after the command runs; the opt-in ask mode makes you confirm irreversible operations before they run.

plugins.name: worktree
plugins.description: Make git worktrees a first-class workspace in Claude Code: list, create, switch, and safely clean parallel worktrees, with the active worktree always visible in the status line. Adds Plan-Driven Lane Execution - one main agent orchestrating several worker sessions, each in its own isolated worktree lane, with delegation gates, a board derived from git, and central integration. Git stays the source of truth, PDLE is opt-in, and the plugin registers zero hooks by default.

plugins.name: sprint-recap
plugins.description: Turn a finished sprint into a narrated walkthrough video of the real app plus a matching HTML reproduction guide. Correlates Azure DevOps iteration items, git history and Claude session transcripts into a reviewable step script, captures one browser clip per step under read-only discipline, renders it with Remotion step-text overlays, and publishes a shareable guide whose credentials stay in a separate gitignored file.
